audience: security teams that track scan results and open findings in Detectify

useCases.title: List open high-severity vulnerabilities
useCases.text: Filter findings by severity and status. Open one finding to see the affected asset and the remediation text.

useCases.title: Check scan status and schedule per scan profile
useCases.text: List the scan profiles, then read the latest scan status and the next scheduled scan of each profile.

useCases.title: Review assets, subdomains and groups
useCases.text: List the root assets with their tokens. Read the subdomains of an asset and the members of a group.

useCases.title: Mark a finding as a false positive or accepted risk
useCases.text: Read the finding first. Then set its status for the whole team, or remove the mark again.
